sentences.QE: Can you come to the party?
sentences.AE: Yes, I would love to. Thank you for inviting me.
sentences.AP: Sim, adoraria. Obrigado por me convidar.

sentences.AE: I am sorry, I cannot make it. I have other plans.
sentences.AP: Desculpe, não posso. Tenho outros compromissos.

sentences.QE: Would you like to join us?
sentences.AE: Sure, count me in. What time?
sentences.AP: Claro, pode me incluir. Que horas?

sentences.AE: She accepted the invitation right away.
sentences.AP: Ela aceitou o convite na hora.

sentences.QE: Are you free on Saturday?
sentences.AE: I am not sure yet. Can I let you know tomorrow?
sentences.AP: Não tenho certeza ainda. Posso avisar amanhã?

sentences.AE: I would love to but I have to work. Maybe next time.
sentences.AP: Adoraria mas tenho que trabalhar. Talvez na próxima.

sentences.QE: Do you want to come?
sentences.AE: Yes, definitely. I have been looking forward to it.
sentences.AP: Sim, com certeza. Estava ansioso por isso.

sentences.AE: He declined politely. He had a family thing.
sentences.AP: Ele recusou com educação. Tinha um compromisso familiar.

sentences.QE: Can you make it to the meeting?
sentences.AE: I am afraid I cannot. I will be out of town.
sentences.AP: Receio que não. Estarei fora da cidade.

sentences.AE: Thank you for the invite. I will be there.
sentences.AP: Obrigado pelo convite. Estarei lá.

sentences.QE: Would you be able to attend?
sentences.AE: Yes, I have put it on my calendar.
sentences.AP: Sim, já coloquei na minha agenda.

sentences.AE: I had to say no. I was double-booked.
sentences.AP: Tive que dizer não. Tinha dois compromissos no mesmo horário.

sentences.QE: Do you want to go out tonight?
sentences.AE: I would like to but I am too tired. Another time?
sentences.AP: Gostaria mas estou muito cansado. Outra hora?

sentences.AE: She said she would try to come. She was not sure.
sentences.AP: Ela disse que tentaria vir. Não tinha certeza.

sentences.QE: Are you coming to the wedding?
sentences.AE: Yes, I would not miss it for the world.
sentences.AP: Sim, não perderia por nada.

sentences.AE: I regret that I cannot attend. Please send my regards.
sentences.AP: Lamento não poder comparecer. Envie meus cumprimentos.

sentences.QE: Can we count on you?
sentences.AE: Absolutely. I will be there.
sentences.AP: Com certeza. Estarei lá.

sentences.AE: He accepted and asked if he could bring a friend.
sentences.AP: Ele aceitou e perguntou se podia trazer um amigo.

sentences.QE: Would it be possible for you to come?
sentences.AE: Let me check. I think I can. I will confirm.
sentences.AP: Deixe-me verificar. Acho que posso. Confirmo.

sentences.AE: I had to turn it down. I was sick.
sentences.AP: Tive que recusar. Estava doente.

sentences.QE: Do you accept the invitation?
sentences.AE: Yes, with pleasure. Thank you.
sentences.AP: Sim, com prazer. Obrigado.

sentences.AE: She could not make it. She sent her apologies.
sentences.AP: Ela não pôde ir. Enviou desculpas.

sentences.QE: Are you in for the trip?
sentences.AE: I am in. When do we leave?
sentences.AP: Topo. Quando partimos?

sentences.AE: I said maybe. I need to see if I can switch my shift.
sentences.AP: Disse talvez. Preciso ver se consigo trocar meu turno.

sentences.QE: Can you join us for dinner?
sentences.AE: I would love to. What can I bring?
sentences.AP: Adoraria. O que posso levar?

sentences.AE: He was sorry he could not come. He had to work.
sentences.AP: Ele lamentou não poder vir. Tinha que trabalhar.

sentences.QE: Do you think you can make it?
sentences.AE: I will do my best. I really want to be there.
sentences.AP: Farei o possível. Quero muito estar lá.

sentences.AE: I had to decline. It was too short notice.
sentences.AP: Tive que recusar. Foi em cima da hora.

sentences.QE: Will you be there?
sentences.AE: Yes, I will. Looking forward to it.
sentences.AP: Sim, estarei. Ansioso por isso.

sentences.AE: She said yes right away. She was excited.
sentences.AP: Ela disse sim na hora. Estava animada.

sentences.QE: Can you come to the baby shower?
sentences.QP: Você pode vir ao chá de bebê?
sentences.AE: Unfortunately I cannot. I will send a gift.
sentences.AP: Infelizmente não posso. Enviarei um presente.

sentences.AE: I accepted. I have already blocked the date.
sentences.AP: Aceitei. Já reservei a data.

sentences.QE: Would you like to be our guest?
sentences.QP: Você gostaria de ser nosso convidado?
sentences.AE: That is very kind. I would be delighted.
sentences.AP: Muito gentil. Ficaria encantado.

sentences.AE: He could not commit. He said he would try.
sentences.AP: Ele não pôde se comprometer. Disse que tentaria.

sentences.QE: Are you able to attend?
sentences.AE: Yes, I am. Thank you for thinking of me.
sentences.AP: Sim, posso. Obrigado por pensar em mim.

sentences.AE: I had to say no. I had another engagement.
sentences.AP: Tive que dizer não. Tinha outro compromisso.

sentences.QE: Do you want to be there?
sentences.AE: Yes, I do. I would not miss it.
sentences.AP: Sim, quero. Não perderia.

sentences.AE: She thanked them but said she could not make it.
sentences.AP: Ela agradeceu mas disse que não poderia ir.

sentences.QE: Can we expect you?
sentences.AE: Yes, you can. I will be there on time.
sentences.AP: Sim. Estarei lá no horário.

sentences.AE: I wish I could but I have a conflict.
sentences.AP: Queria poder mas tenho um conflito.

sentences.QE: Would you come if we changed the date?
sentences.QP: Você viria se mudássemos a data?
sentences.AE: Maybe. Let me check. I could do the following week.
sentences.AP: Talvez. Deixe-me ver. Poderia na semana seguinte.

sentences.AE: He said he would come. He confirmed yesterday.
sentences.AP: Ele disse que viria. Confirmou ontem.

sentences.QE: Do you need to check your schedule?
sentences.AE: Yes, give me a moment. I will get back to you.
sentences.AP: Sim, me dá um momento. Retorno para você.

sentences.AE: I am so sorry I cannot come. I hope you have a great time.
sentences.AP: Sinto muito não poder ir. Espero que se divirtam.

sentences.QE: Will you join us?
sentences.AE: Yes, I will. It sounds like fun.
sentences.AP: Sim. Parece divertido.

sentences.AE: She was happy to accept. She marked her calendar.
sentences.AP: Ela ficou feliz em aceitar. Marcou na agenda.

sentences.QE: Can you make it or not?
sentences.AE: I can. Count me in. Thanks.
sentences.AP: Posso. Pode me incluir. Obrigado.

sentences.AE: I had to refuse. I was not feeling well.
sentences.AP: Tive que recusar. Não estava me sentindo bem.

sentences.QE: Would you consider coming?
sentences.AE: I would. Let me see if I can rearrange things.
sentences.AP: Consideraria. Deixe-me ver se consigo remarcar.

sentences.AE: He said no but offered to help with the planning.
sentences.AP: Ele disse não mas se ofereceu para ajudar no planejamento.

sentences.QE: Are you coming or not?
sentences.AE: I am coming. I already said yes.
sentences.AP: Vou. Já disse que sim.

sentences.AE: I accepted with pleasure. I cannot wait.
sentences.AP: Aceitei com prazer. Mal posso esperar.

sentences.QE: Do you have to decline?
sentences.AE: I am afraid so. I have a prior commitment.
sentences.AP: Receio que sim. Tenho um compromisso anterior.

sentences.AE: She was unable to attend. She sent her best wishes.
sentences.AP: Ela não pôde comparecer. Enviou os melhores votos.
